factual_claims.claim: Estonia-Finland passenger numbers increased 1.8%, supporting a EUR 1.7 million increase in route revenue to EUR 314.5 million, although the segment result declined by EUR 10.9 million to EUR 70.4 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The number of passengers carried on the Estonia-Finland route increased by 1.8% year-on-year... Revenue from the Estonia-Finland route increased by EUR 1.7 million to EUR 314.5 million... The segment result decreased by EUR 10.9 million to EUR 70.4 million.'

factual_claims.claim: Finland-Sweden revenue fell EUR 3.3 million to EUR 225.5 million, with the segment result decreasing to EUR 1.3 million, partly reflecting 68 days of vessel maintenance.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'In the financial year 2025, the number of passengers on the Finland-Sweden routes decreased by 2.4%... The routes' revenue decreased by EUR 3.3 million to EUR 225.5 million... The segment result decreased by EUR 1.5 million to EUR 1.3 million... The routes’ results were impacted by maintenance works on the cruise ferries Silja Serenade and Baltic Princess that totalled 68 days in the first quarter of 2025.'

factual_claims.claim: Estonia-Sweden revenue declined EUR 12.1 million to EUR 85.3 million, while its loss narrowed to EUR 1.2 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Year-on-year, the revenue of the Estonia-Sweden routes decreased by EUR 12.1 million to EUR 85.3 million... The segment result improved by EUR 1.4 million to a loss of EUR 1.2 million.'

factual_claims.claim: Restaurant and shop sales, nearly half of total revenue, decreased to EUR 366.4 million from EUR 376.0 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Restaurant and shop sales onboard and on shore totalled EUR 366.4 million (EUR 376.0 million in financial year 2024) accounting for almost half of total revenue.'

factual_claims.claim: Cargo transportation revenue fell to EUR 77.9 million from EUR 88.6 million, and charter revenue declined to EUR 54.9 million from EUR 62.0 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Sales of cargo transport to EUR 77.9 million (EUR 88.6 million in financial year 2024)... Revenue from chartering vessels amounted to EUR 54.9 million compared to EUR 62.0 million in the financial year 2024.'

factual_claims.claim: Personnel expenses increased 4.3% to EUR 201.0 million, while fuel and emission costs were broadly stable at EUR 96.5 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Total personnel expenses amounted to EUR 201.0 million (EUR 192.8 million in FY24)... Fuel and emission costs for the financial year 2025 amounted to EUR 96.5 million (EUR 95.8 million in the financial year 2024).'

factual_claims.claim: Depreciation and amortisation fell EUR 18.0 million to EUR 79.8 million, primarily because vessel useful lives were extended to 45 years and three vessels were sold.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Amortisation and depreciation expense decreased by EUR 18.0 million to EUR 79.8 million year-on-year... Depreciation expense decreased mainly due to the alignment of the estimated useful lives of the cruise and passenger vessels (except for shuttle vessels) to 45 years... The decline in depreciation expense was further impacted by the sale of three vessels in the financial year 2025.'

factual_claims.claim: The Group sold Star I, Regal Star and Sailor and ended the year with no vessels in lay-up.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'During the financial year, the Group completed the sale of three vessels. The passenger vessel Star I was sold... the cargo vessel Regal Star... and the cargo vessel Sailor... As at the end of the financial year, the Group operated 11 vessels including 2 shuttle vessels, 6 passenger vessels and 3 vessels that were chartered out. The number of vessels in lay-up decreased from four at the end of the first quarter of 2025 to zero by the end of the third quarter of 2025.'

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash flow remained positive at EUR 127.1 million, although below EUR 153.4 million in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The Group’s net operating cash flow for the financial year 2025 was positive at EUR 127.1 million (EUR 153.4 million in the financial year 2024).'

factual_claims.claim: Proceeds from vessel disposals contributed EUR 78.8 million to investing cash flow.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Net cash flow from investing activities was EUR 46.1 million (EUR 3.2 million in the financial year 2024), including proceeds from disposals of EUR 78.8 million.'

factual_claims.claim: Interest-bearing liabilities declined 19.9% to EUR 445.9 million and net debt to EUR 432.4 million, while the equity ratio improved to 56.4%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'As at 31 December 2025, the Group’s net debt amounted to EUR 432.4 million compared to EUR 537.7 million as at 31 December 2024... The net debt to EBITDA ratio stood at 3.3 as at 31 December 2025 (3.1 as at 31 December 2024)... Equity ratio 56.4% (2024: 53.4%).'

factual_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents were EUR 13.5 million, supplemented by EUR 96.9 million of unused overdraft facilities.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'At 31 December 2025, the Group’s cash and cash equivalents totalled EUR 13.5 million (EUR 18.7 million at 31 December 2024)... In addition, available unused overdraft credit lines amounted to EUR 96.9 million (EUR 75.0 million in 2024).'

factual_claims.claim: A dividend of EUR 0.06 per share, totalling EUR 44.6 million, was paid, and the same dividend is proposed for 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on 20 May 2025 adopted a resolution to pay a dividend of EUR 0.06 per share in 2025 in the total amount of EUR 44.6 million... In agreement with the Supervisory Board of the Group, the Management Board of the Group will propose to the General Meeting of Shareholders that a dividend of EUR 0.06 per share be paid in 2026.'
